scope: Same eight predeclared frames. Qualitative process and shape review; not a full-model quality verdict or motion metric.
normal_observations: Normal moves the mop toward the foreground, with a more compact head than no_c in several frames. A mid-late frame has a faded/doubled-looking head and blurred handle.
A large reflective wet region remains. The required disappearance of water along the mop path is not clearly demonstrated.
no_c_observations: No_c produces a broader, stretched mop head and irregular handle/head geometry. Normal reduces some deformation but does not establish a correct absorption/cleanup process.
